projects_intro: Twenty-three projects across data engineering, BI, machine learning, deep learning, automation and networking. Filter by area.

projects.title: Metadata-driven pipeline framework on Databricks
projects.subtitle: New sources by configuration, not code
projects.desc: A framework that generates ingestion and transformation pipelines from metadata, so new sources are added by configuration instead of code.
bullets: Medallion (Lakehouse) architecture, designed end to end
Orchestration and data governance built in
Final layer connected to BI dashboards

projects.title: Delta Lake Lakehouse: French public drug database
projects.subtitle: Open data with transactions and time travel
projects.desc: Ingested and transformed French open data on medicines with PySpark, then moved it to Delta tables.
bullets: Parquet → Delta Lake with transactions and schema evolution
Time travel to audit history and restore earlier states
Join tuning: broadcast, shuffle, sort-merge, coalesce

projects.title: Parallel ETL pipeline with Airflow on AWS EC2
projects.subtitle: Weather data, extracted and delivered every day
projects.desc: A daily Airflow pipeline that runs two extraction branches at the same time, joins them in PostgreSQL and delivers the result to Amazon S3.
projects.flow: [S3 CSV → RDS Postgres] ∥ [Weather API → transform → Postgres] → SQL join → S3
bullets: Airflow installed and run on an AWS EC2 instance (Ubuntu, Python virtual environment)
Branch 1: a city reference file (state, 2020 census, land area) imported from S3 straight into an Amazon RDS PostgreSQL database with the `aws_s3` extension and an IAM role

Branch 2: an HTTP sensor checks that the OpenWeatherMap API is up, then the current weather is extracted as JSON, transformed with pandas (Kelvin to Fahrenheit, local timestamps for record, sunrise and sunset) and bulk-loaded into Postgres
Both branches run in parallel inside an Airflow TaskGroup, then a SQL inner join enriches the weather data with city attributes
The joined dataset is written to S3 as a timestamped CSV; daily schedule with automatic retries

projects.title: MLOps: deploying machine learning models with FastAPI and Docker
projects.subtitle: From notebook to production API
projects.desc: Took trained machine learning models out of the notebook and into production as a containerised API.
bullets: ML models served through a FastAPI REST API for real-time predictions
Application containerised with Docker for reproducible deployment
Fully automated CI/CD pipeline: build, test and deploy on every change
API documented and testable with Swagger

projects.title: Weather analytics dashboard with WeatherAPI
projects.subtitle: Live weather and air quality at a glance
projects.desc: Turned live JSON from a weather REST API into an interactive Power BI dashboard.
projects.flow: API → Extract → Power Query / M → Model → DAX → Visuals
bullets: Temperature, humidity, wind, visibility, UV index, precipitation
Air quality (AQI) indicators
Data model and DAX measures built for exploration

projects.title: Apple carbon emissions analysis
projects.subtitle: One dashboard for investors, one for the sustainability team
projects.desc: Dashboards tracking Apple's carbon performance by product line.
bullets: Data cleaning and preparation with Excel and Power Query
Star-schema data model with DAX measures

projects.title: Gas turbine CO and NOx emissions
projects.subtitle: What drives turbine emissions?
projects.desc: Statistics project on 2011–2015 turbine sensor data, aimed at cutting CO and NOx emissions.
bullets: Web scraping (rvest), merging, min-max scaling, KNN outlier imputation
Normality checks, variance tests, Kruskal-Wallis and Kendall tau
Linear regression for NOx, deployed behind an API and a web app

projects.title: Transport demand model for the Ariège department
projects.subtitle: From census data to commuter traffic on real roads
projects.desc: Built an end-to-end transport demand model for a French department from open data, from who lives and works where to individual trips routed on the actual road network.
projects.flow: Census + URSSAF → generation → attraction → gravity model → trips → OSM routing → QGIS
bullets: Territorial analysis with weighted INSEE census microdata: age structure (mean age 46.6) and socio-professional categories by municipality, mapped with GeoPandas
Jobs vs resident workers per municipality from URSSAF data, revealing a few employment hubs and many commuter towns
Linear trip generation by socio-professional category, proportional attraction, then a doubly-constrained gravity model across 327 municipalities (converged in 46 iterations, about 17,900 flows)
Flows disaggregated into individual trips with random origins, destinations and morning departure times
Trips routed on the OpenStreetMap road network with OSMnx and NetworkX, link flows exported as a GeoPackage and mapped in QGIS

projects.title: Brown-Gibson model for multi-criteria decisions
projects.subtitle: Cost data and expert judgment in one score
projects.desc: Studied and applied the Brown-Gibson location-selection model, which blends cost data and expert judgment into one score.
bullets: Critical factors as pass/fail screening
Objective factors from annual costs, subjective factors from paired comparisons
Final ranking: LPM = k·OF + (1 − k)·SF

projects.title: Plant seedlings classification
projects.subtitle: 12 look-alike species, 0.966 micro-F1
projects.desc: Image classifier that tells apart 12 seedling species that look nearly identical at early growth stages.
bullets: Compared a baseline CNN, an enhanced CNN, a ResNet-style network and EfficientNetB0
Class weights and augmentation to handle an imbalanced dataset
Final EfficientNet: 0.966 micro-F1 on Kaggle, deployed as a web app

projects.title: Explainable AI for plant seedlings
projects.subtitle: Checking that the model looks at the plant
projects.desc: Opened up the EfficientNet classifier to check it learns real plant features, not background.
bullets: LIME, SHAP, Grad-CAM and Integrated Gradients compared side by side
Counterfactual explanations to map which species the model confuses
Found the main failure mode: over-reliance on blade tips for grass species

projects.title: InsurPrime: fire insurance premium prediction
projects.subtitle: Pricing fire risk for farm insurance
projects.desc: Predicted the pure fire premium of agricultural multi-risk contracts for a Crédit Agricole Assurances case study.
bullets: 374 features, 38% missing values, zero-inflated targets
Tested GLM (Poisson, Tweedie), Lasso, hybrid decision tree and Random Forest
Lasso kept as the final model: best realistic RMSE, still interpretable

projects.title: Autonomous driving agent: Car Racing v2
projects.subtitle: An agent that learns to drive on its own
projects.desc: Trained an agent to drive with continuous control of acceleration, braking and steering in Gymnasium.
bullets: Implemented and compared DQN, PPO and A2C

projects.title: LLM-driven multi-agent trading simulation
projects.subtitle: Trader agents that read the news
projects.desc: A simulated financial market where trader agents powered by Google Gemini 2.5 read unstructured news and act on it.
bullets: Hybrid population: reactive traders (momentum, contrarian, noise), a market maker for liquidity, and cognitive traders (cautious and aggressive) driven by an LLM
Gemini 2.5 used as a signal processor, not a chatbot: each Kaggle news headline becomes a structured sentiment and risk score
Continuous double auction order book in Mesa; agents coordinate only through the price (stigmergy)
50 runs per scenario, LLM off vs on: the LLM signal increased trading volume and volatility

projects.title: FarmWise: smart agriculture platform
projects.subtitle: Six prediction tools for farmers in one app
projects.desc: A desktop decision tool for farmers that brings several prediction models into one app.
bullets: Olive detection and yield prediction from field photos (YOLO)
Crop disease detection from a leaf photo, with pesticide recommendations
Crop suitability from soil and climate data (N, P, K, temperature, humidity, pH, rainfall)
Rainfall forecast and irrigation calculator by weather station and crop
Olive oil price prediction in TND from market conditions
Crop rotation assistant built on LLaMA 3, plus 3D reconstruction from images (TensorFlow)

projects.title: Hand gesture recognition with OpenCV
projects.subtitle: Control the app with a wave of the hand
projects.desc: A touch-free way to use the FarmWise app: the webcam reads hand gestures in real time and turns them into commands.
bullets: A separate “Hand Gesture Control” window runs next to the app and processes the webcam stream frame by frame with OpenCV
The hand is detected in each frame and its key points and finger joints are drawn live, so the user sees what the model tracks
Finger positions are classified into gestures: **open hand**, **closed fist** and **thumbs up**
A “None” state when no known gesture is shown, so random movements trigger nothing
The detected gesture is printed on the video in real time, and each gesture is mapped to an action in the app, such as working through the disease detection page

projects.title: AI scheduling agent with n8n
projects.subtitle: Book a meeting just by chatting
projects.desc: A chat assistant that books and manages appointments in Google Calendar on its own, built as an n8n AI agent workflow.
projects.flow: Chat message → AI Agent (OpenAI + memory) → Google Calendar / Google Sheets
bullets: Triggered by a chat message: the user simply asks for a slot in plain language
n8n AI Agent node with an OpenAI chat model and conversation memory, so it keeps the context of the exchange
Google Calendar connected as tools: the agent checks availability and creates the events itself
Google Sheets connected as tools to record and read the booking data
The new appointments appear directly in the calendar

Title, author, description, rating, price, stock

Clinic back office: one-click accept or decline, PDF export, search, sorting and pagination

User accounts with profile management
Admin dashboard: reservations, donations and regions, with search and statistics charts by location

projects.title: Switched network for an insurance company
projects.subtitle: Six workshops, from the first switch to full redundancy
projects.desc: Built and configured the switched network of STAR, an insurance company case study, zone by zone in Cisco Packet Tracer with Cisco IOS commands.
projects.flow: Switch setup → VLANs → Inter-VLAN → STP → EtherChannel → HSRP
bullets: Basic switch configuration and security: hostname, encrypted passwords, console and VTY access, MOTD banner, port security against intrusions
VLANs by department, a management VLAN and a native VLAN, 802.1Q trunks and DTP to cut broadcast traffic
Inter-VLAN routing two ways: one physical router interface per VLAN, then router-on-a-stick with sub-interfaces, with 802.1Q tags checked in simulation mode
STP and PVST+ against Layer 2 loops: root bridge election, port selection by cost and priority, primary and secondary root, edge ports that skip to forwarding
EtherChannel link aggregation with PAgP and LACP for more throughput and fault tolerance
HSRP first-hop redundancy for the DMZ: active and standby routers, priorities and preemption, failover tested

projects.title: M/M/1 queue simulation with OMNeT++
projects.subtitle: Queueing theory, checked against a simulation
projects.desc: Simulated a single-server M/M/1 queue in OMNeT++ with the INET queueing library, then compared the measured performance with the theoretical formulas.
projects.flow: Poisson arrivals → queue → single server → SQLite results → analysis
bullets: Arrival and service times drawn from exponential distributions: λ = 1/0.79 ≈ 1.266 and µ = 1/0.75 ≈ 1.333 packets per second
Simulation configured in omnetpp.ini and results exported to SQLite for querying
Time-averaged queue length and queueing time computed over a 1,000-second run
PacketQueue.cc modified in C++ to timestamp each packet on arrival and record its queueing time as a signal and a packet tag
Simulated metrics validated against the M/M/1 theoretical results

projects.title: VoltVault: smart EV charging station management

RFID access on Arduino UNO: an LCD screen asks for the card, then a green LED grants access if the ID exists and a red LED denies it
Also shown in the demo: action history, QR codes, photo upload, Excel export, map display, mailing and a built-in calculator
